name: llmfit
description_en: Hundreds of models & providers. One command to find what runs on your hardware.
readme_excerpt: llmfit English · 中文 · 日本語 > 📊 New: benchmark & share — real numbers from your machine, better estimates for everyone. Download a model, serve it, and measure real tok/s on your hardware — then contribute the results back to the project as a PR, straight from the TUI. No gh CLI, no third-party account. Every run is saved locally first, your own measurements replace estimates in the fit table, and each merged submission ships in the next release: anyone on identical hardware gets measured ✓ numb…
